build.title: Agent jobs: hire agents to own recurring jobs (job-type@1, crew, router, Jobs view)

said.text: recurring kinds of work (walkthroughs, site checks, screenshots, landing, banner cleanup, listener QA) go to hired swarm agents instead of anonymous one-off builds. HR department stays shelved.

steps.text: job-type@1 asset type: rules, both validators, schema, starters, check
Hire the crew: six agents, skills, notes
Router: agent-job.mjs (owner, duty, budget, brief, headless launch, run recorded), unassigned + hire
Breakroom Jobs view + card jobs + console button + server routes
Tests, RULES section, install_steps Part J, screenshots, report

tests.name: agent-swarm/test.mjs: 67 → 80 checks. New: six starters valid and each owned by one crew member; bad job type named and never routed; routing to the owner on the job's model with its cap; owner off duty → not routed; budget check (pay left under the cap, broke); unassigned → hire → routed; brief car

Local CI block: the Node engine sweep (validate 471 assets, tracker, plugins, projects, builds store, UI Review, theme, controls, plugin pages, feature matrix, catalog, axf_server), all 45 tsx/node checks of the web test block (menu-reach included), console tsc + vite build, theme-swap.mjs green.
plugin-lifecycle check agent-swarm: clean apart from untracked local session logs in this worktree (not in git).

open: No live run measured yet: the end-to-end test uses a fake launcher and a recorded stream.

Schedules and events don't fire by themselves: `agent-job.mjs due --run` / `event <name> --run` need a cron line or a hook (install_steps step 34). Wiring `build.finished` to the lander is a follow-up.
`amberx-walkthrough` has no re-record command yet; Rhonda takes it over when the amberx-walkthrough build lands (edit `command` in its job type).

Agent cap: agent-cap landed on main during this build. Job runs go through `deploy/claude-headless.sh`, so the cap and queue apply; a run the cap queues is recorded with its queue position and stays open until a desk frees (given up after a day). The swarm's desk count also counts the job crew when they're on duty.
Claude Code still loads CLAUDE.md from the worktree it runs in; the system line tells the agent not to read more.
Kotlin twin of job-type@1 deferred (Android on hold).
